projects.title: Argentum [Ag]
projects.summary: Build in public, prove it forever. A Web3 social space for builders to log real-time updates and secure proof of work on-chain.
projects.whatItIs: A decentralized 'Twitter for Devs' where creators share progress logs, code snippets, and anchor proof of build history directly onto the blockchain.
projects.whyItExists: To give open-source builders an tamper-proof way to establish proof of creation and build in public with cryptographic authenticity.
projects.problem: Traditional developer updates on centralized social platforms lack verifiable proof of ownership and can be silenced or tampered with.
projects.solution: Built an on-chain build-logging protocol with cryptographic timestamping and decentralized storage for developer logs.
projects.experience: A clean, modern social interface for developers to post build logs, inspect cryptographic hashes, and verify project history.

homepage.description: Build in Public Protocol • On-chain Proof • Developer Social

notes: Active prototype undergoing smart contract auditing and testnet deployment.

projects.title: Hedera Multi-Chain Visualizer
projects.summary: Real-time cross-chain consensus & network throughput visualizer covering Hedera Hashgraph, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon.
projects.whatItIs: An interactive WebGL/Canvas visualizer rendering live transaction throughput, block consensus, and latency across major DLT networks.
projects.whyItExists: To visually demonstrate the speed and consensus difference between classic Proof-of-Work / Proof-of-Stake blockchains and Hedera's Hashgraph DAG consensus.
projects.problem: Comparing blockchain speeds and finality times textually fails to convey real-world consensus dynamics to stakeholders and developers.
projects.solution: Engineered real-time WebSocket feeds connected to network nodes rendering high-fps visual particle streams per transaction.
projects.experience: High-performance visual dashboard with live toggle controls across Hedera, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon.

homepage.description: Multi-chain Visualizer • Hedera Hashgraph • Real-time WebSockets

projects.title: NexaDeFi Platform & DEX
projects.summary: Full-stack Web3 Decentralized Finance dashboard featuring automated DEX token swaps, staking liquidity pools, and MetaMask integration.
projects.whatItIs: A comprehensive DeFi platform enabling seamless token swaps, liquidity provision, yield calculation, and real-time wallet portfolio inspection.
projects.whyItExists: To showcase end-to-end Web3 fullstack architecture integrating smart contracts with responsive, high-speed dApp user interfaces.
projects.problem: DeFi interfaces are often cluttered and intimidating for non-expert users.
projects.solution: Designed a sleek, reactive UI with intuitive slip-tolerance controls, gas estimation, and dynamic transaction notification toasts.
projects.experience: A responsive, glassmorphic DeFi application with instant wallet connect and real-time market rate charts.

homepage.description: DeFi Protocol • DEX Token Swap • Staking Vaults • Next.js

projects.title: Crypto Portfolio Tracker CLI
projects.summary: Terminal-based cryptocurrency portfolio manager powered by CoinGecko API and Hedera Token Service (HTS) integration.
projects.whatItIs: A high-efficiency CLI tool that monitors live market rates, calculates profit/loss per asset, tracks HTS tokens, and visualizes investment targets.
projects.whyItExists: Developers spend considerable time in the terminal; having a rapid, zero-overhead portfolio inspector eliminates switching context to heavy browser tabs.
projects.problem: Web dashboards are bloated and slow when all a developer needs is a instant command-line check of their token portfolio status.
projects.solution: Built a modular Python CLI with colorized formatted tables, JSON state persistence, multi-currency conversion, and CoinGecko API integration.
projects.experience: A crisp, color-coded terminal dashboard that loads under 200ms.

homepage.description: Python CLI • CoinGecko API • Hedera HTS • Terminal UX

projects.title: Debugr — Smart Contract Inspector
projects.summary: Interactive developer suite for inspecting EVM smart contract state diffs, execution traces, and ABI event decoding.
projects.whatItIs: A lightweight developer tool that dissects Ethereum / EVM transaction logs, decodes function call signatures, and flags potential security pitfalls.
projects.whyItExists: To simplify debugging for smart contract developers and security auditors before deploying to mainnet.
projects.problem: Debugging raw bytecodes and unformatted logs on block explorers is slow and error-prone.
projects.solution: Created an automated parser that binds contract ABIs to raw transaction logs and highlights state storage modifications.
projects.experience: A clean side-by-side transaction trace inspector with syntax-highlighted storage variables.

homepage.description: Dev Suite • EVM Trace Inspector • ABI Decoding • TypeScript

projects.title: Open Dev Data Taxonomy
projects.summary: An open taxonomy, metric framework, and dataset mapping cryptocurrency, blockchain, and decentralized ecosystems.
projects.whatItIs: A structured data taxonomy categorizing open-source Web3 repositories, protocol layers, developer activity metrics, and ecosystem governance.
projects.whyItExists: To create a standardized framework for analyzing developer growth and technical adoption across crypto networks.
projects.problem: Decentralized ecosystem data is scattered across thousands of disparate repositories without a unified taxonomy.
projects.solution: Designed a systematic taxonomy organizing projects by L0/L1/L2 infrastructure, middleware, primitives, and application layers.
projects.experience: An extensible data specification and documentation standard for researchers and builders.

homepage.description: Data Taxonomy • Crypto Metrics • Open Source Research
